title: Transition function of a compiled register program
statement: Let $A$ assign an instruction to each label in $\Lambda$, and let $l_0,l\in\Lambda$, phase $ph$, input symbol $a\in\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and work-tape symbols $w:\mathrm{Fin}(m)\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ be given. The transition of the compiled register program from initial label $l_0$, at state $(l,ph)$ with scanned symbols $a$ and $w$, is the action prescribed by the instruction at $l$ for label $l$, phase $ph$, and those scanned symbols.
